Card C08623-K2 has four prior confirmed-fraud closed cases (CC-4957, CC-3682, CC-2935, and CC-2817) exhibiting out-of-region card-present fraud where cardholders reported unauthorized physical transactions while retaining possession of the card.
Flagged transaction 3530164 has no recurring history and the holder profile in region 330 has no activity prior to companion transaction 3530056 on the same day.
The calibrated fraud model evaluated flagged transaction 3530164 at 0.028 with a historical fraud rate of 0.6%.

Billing region 330 recorded 2,088 transactions across 390 cards during the 7-day window with a hot share of 0.0053 and a lift of 0.26 versus baseline, indicating region 330 is not an active fraud cluster.
Card C08623-K2 sits in Louvain community 101711929 with 3 cards, 2 of which have confirmed fraud cases, yielding a 66.7% community fraud rate and a lift of 6.6 over baseline.

case.summary: Customer C08623 reported an unauthorized in-person purchase of $49.00 (transaction 3530164) in unfamiliar billing region 330. Investigation identified a linked companion transaction of $116.93 (3530056) occurring 49 minutes prior under the same holder identity, which scored 0.622 on the calibrated fraud model with a 64.5% historical fraud rate. Additionally, card C08623-K2 has four prior confirmed-fraud cases (CC-4957, CC-3682, CC-2935, and CC-2817) involving out-of-region card-present cloning where the legitimate holder retained the card. With no legitimate prior history in region 330, the activity represents confirmed out-of-region physical fraud with total exposure of $165.93, resulting in card blocking and case creation.
